description: World Bank open data as a dataset: one indicator (alias gdp|gdp_per_capita|gdp_growth|population|inflation|unemployment|life_expectancy|co2_per_capita|internet_users|exports_pct_gdp, or any WDI code like NY.GDP.MKTP.CD) for up to 20 ISO country codes (country=AU;NZ;US) over a year range (from=2015&to=2025). Returns rows plus a ready-to-save CSV. Data CC BY 4.0. Costs 0.01 USDC on Base via x402, or 12 sats Cashu ecash (NUT-24), or 12 sats over Lightning (L402).
name: dataset_worldbank
